subject: Pricing footnote exemptions & procurement snippets for AWS listing
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pricing footnote exemptions & procurement snippets for AWS listing

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for taking the listing conversation last week. Two asks from procurement/product that we want to tidy up before we submit the final marketplace assets:

1) Pricing footnote exemptions: your procurement team indicated there may be exemptions for BYO (bring-your-own) entitlements and certain private-offer trial arrangements. Can you confirm the exact language they want included? We typically provide a short footnote (1–2 lines) and an expanded FAQ entry.

2) Procurement snippets: attached is our procurement_snippets_template.xlsx with the fields marketplace teams usually expect (billing cadence, metering unit, trial length, private offer footnote). Could you review and populate the required fields so we match your legal/procurement playbook?

Attachments: procurement_snippets_template.xlsx (template), pricing_questions.docx (specific Qs we pulled from AWS listing guidelines).

Goal: finalize copy by Oct 25 so we can hand off to AWS marketplace ops for upload. Are you available for a 20-30 minute sync next week if there are follow-ups?

Thanks —
Logan Wright
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.ai
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-19T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing footnote exemptions & procurement snippets for AWS listing

Hi Logan —

Appreciate the clear checklist. A couple quick notes from Acme legal/procurement:

- For BYO entitlements we require the phrase: "Customers using BYO entitlements are responsible for their own licensing and associated fees; marketplace charges apply only to the portion billed through AWS."
- Private offers: our procurement team will accept a trial footnote limited to 30 days unless otherwise negotiated. If you want a longer trial on a private offer we need a written exception and a short justification.
- Metering: our preference is per-API-call with associated token-equivalent explanation; we can accept per-1k-token equivalency if that aligns with your SKU.

I've attached Acme_procurement_requirements.pdf with our internal boilerplate. Happy to jump on a call Oct 22 at 11am PT — that works for me.

Thanks,
Samir Patel
Head of Procurement
Acme Analytics
samir.patel@acmeanalytics.com

Subject: Re: Pricing footnote exemptions & procurement snippets for AWS listing

Logan — quick internal notes (see attached pricing_footnotes_draft.pdf):

- I drafted three variants for the BYO footnote: short (one line), medium (one sentence + link to FAQ), and long (one sentence + example). My suggestion is to use the medium as default and long for the FAQ.
- For private offers, add an explicit "Private Offer Trial: subject to buyer negotiation" line to avoid implying automatic extended trial windows.
- Metering copy: include a parenthetical "(equivalent to 1,000 tokens)" where we mention per-API-call metering, AWS teams appreciate concrete equivalencies.

If you want I can merge these into the procurement_snippets_template.xlsx and return a single sheet to send upstream.

Kimberly Park
Marketplace Operations
Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai

Subject: Finalized footnotes + procurement snippet sheet for listing submission

Samir / AWS team —

Thanks for the quick turn. Attached are the consolidated artifacts:
- pricing_footnotes_draft.pdf (3 variants; recommended = medium)
- procurement_snippets_filled.xlsx (we merged Kimberly's edits with Acme requirements)

Key asks:
1) Samir: confirm the BYO phrase below is acceptable and sign off on the 30-day private-offer default. If Acme needs an exception, please attach the justification you referenced on our call.

BYO footnote (recommended): "Customers using BYO entitlements are responsible for associated licensing and fees; marketplace charges apply only to usage processed through AWS. See FAQ for examples."

2) AWS Marketplace team: can you confirm this phrasing meets listing policy for private offers and the listings page? Specifically we want to ensure the private-offer trial note is permitted and that the metering parenthetical ("equivalent to 1,000 tokens") is allowed in the price unit description.

3) Next steps: if all good we plan to submit to the marketplace console on Oct 28. Please confirm by EOB Oct 26 so we can proceed. HubSpot deal link: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/ACME-2026-019

Attachments: pricing_footnotes_draft.pdf, procurement_snippets_filled.xlsx

Thanks —
Logan Wright
